reason: EPTI-style private Transformer inference under secure two-party secret sharing replaces expensive Softmax/GELU evaluations with specialized operator approximations (Multiplicative Residual Softmax), cutting communication volume 10.2-25.4% and end-to-end latency up to 41.7% on WAN emulation; it targets private-inference efficiency for generic Transformers rather than LLM serving specifically.
title: Efficient and performant Transformer private inference with heterogeneous attention mechanisms
